lines.context: Melancholic Viking：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: I wish I could remember what it felt like!
lines.zh: 真想再记起当时的感觉啊!
lines.raw: I wish I could remember what it felt like!

lines.context: Melancholic Viking：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: Sadly, my memory is now my worst enemy.
lines.zh: 可惜啊，如今最跟我过不去的，就是这记性。
lines.raw: Sadly, my memory is now my worst enemy.

lines.context: Melancholic Viking：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: Please, help me remember the sea!
lines.zh: 求你了，帮我找回关于大海的记忆吧!
